firing.source: class C extends React.Component { state = { a: 1 }; render(){ return null; } }

findings.message: Unused state field: 'a'. Nothing in this component reads it, so every write to it re-renders for a value no one looks at, and a reader has to search the whole class before they can be sure it is dead.
